description: This source file defines the ContentManagementEvents class, which contains static methods for managing content-related operations such as updating static values, creating static values, and updating publish links within the Apache OFBiz content management system.

classes.name: ContentManagementEvents
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods for handling content management events in OFBiz, including updating static content values and managing publish link associations.

methods.name: updateStaticValues
methods.description: Updates static values for a specified parent placeholder, managing content associations based on user permissions and input parameters.

methods.name: createStaticValue
methods.description: Placeholder method for creating a static value; currently returns success without implementation.

methods.name: updatePublishLinks
methods.description: Updates publish link associations between content and websites, enabling or disabling content links based on user input and permissions.
